[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by XL.
The following will activate when the Ability used is Lethal Strikes, Imaginary Shot, Etude Snipe, or Qwaser Waltz:
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 4XL.

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M
